title: Relative $\mathbb{A}^1$-Contractibility of Smooth Schemes and Exotic Motivic Spheres
summary: One of the emerging problems in algebraic geometry is to characterize the affine $n$-space $\mathbb{A}^n$ among smooth affine schemes up to $\mathbb{A}^1$-contractibility. Recent efforts show that this characterization holds in dimensions $n<3$ over certain fields. In this thesis, we extend this observation to "reasonably" arbitrary base schemes in relative dimensions $d<3$, exploiting the Zariski local triviality and the triviality of the sheaf of relative differentials.
